subject: E-Commerce
title: Social Proof Engineering
description: A 60-second lesson on Social Proof Engineering.

hook.text: '47 people are viewing this item right now.' That notification is often fabricated. Social proof can be manufactured.

buildup.text: Real social proof—reviews, purchase counts, 'best seller' badges—genuinely helps buyers make better decisions.

discovery.text: Dark pattern social proof uses fake urgency and fake popularity to pressure buying. The numbers aren't real.

twist.text: Studies show that even knowing social proof might be fake doesn't eliminate its persuasive effect on purchasing.

climax.text: Social proof is powerful precisely because we're wired to follow the crowd. Fake or real, it shifts behavior.

punchline.text: '47 people viewing'—probably fake. Social proof works even when we suspect.

quiz.question: Why is manufactured social proof effective despite people knowing it might be fake?
options: Humans are psychologically wired to follow crowd behavior regardless of skepticism
